name: Elemental Totem, Greater – Earth (Su)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Earth Totem

Benefit(s): While raging, the barbarian’s skin becomes as hard as stone. If the barbarian is hit with a manufactured weapon while raging, the weapon takes an amount of damage equal to half that dealt to the barbarian (ignoring damage reduction).
